name: reverse-lunge-with-lateral-flexion
instructions:
1. Stand in an upright position with your feet together and arms at your sides.
2. Step backward into a reverse lunge pattern with the back leg knee slightly bent and your torso upright.
3. Reach overhead and rotate your torso over the front leg while simultaneously exhaling and laterally flexing at the spine.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
